name: conflict_propose
description: Submit an LLM-arbitrated merge resolution for a specific conflict hunk. This is the ONLY conflict tool injected into pi; all other conflict operations are deterministic `shuttle conflict *` subcommands. Use this tool ONLY for L2 semantic hunks that auto3way could not resolve. The merged_text MUST NOT contain any conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>). After calling this tool, shuttle supervisor will run verify + stage automatically.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the conflicted file (e.g. 'src/main.rs'). Must match a file returned by `shuttle conflict list`.

hunk_id.description: Zero-based hunk index within the file. Must match a hunk returned by `shuttle conflict get-hunk`.

merged_text.description: The resolved text to replace the entire conflict hunk region. Must not contain any conflict markers. Should preserve the logical intent of BOTH sides.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of why this merge preserves both sides' intent. Used for audit trail in the ConflictReceipt.

annotations.side_effects: Overwrites the hunk byte range in `file` on disk. Does NOT stage (git add) — shuttle supervisor gates verify before staging.
safety_invariants: only covers hunk_id byte range — never touches other hunks
shuttle supervisor will run `shuttle conflict verify` before accepting
